database_read_only_query: SELECT i.id,i.iid,p.path,n.path,i.title,i.updated_at,i.state_id FROM issues i JOIN issue_assignees ia ON ia.issue_id=i.id JOIN projects p ON p.id=i.project_id JOIN namespaces n ON n.id=p.namespace_id WHERE ia.user_id=2330 AND i.title ILIKE '%better%' ORDER BY i.updated_at DESC,i.id DESC
